items.title: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron, Boy Genius: The Complete Series (DVD ISOs)
items.description:
The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron, Boy Genius: The Complete Series

This is a rip of the full 10-disc DVD set of the complete series released in 2021.

Scans of the DVD art are included, and one of them includes the list of episodes.
